login.title: Welcome to Wuthering.club, Wanderers!
login.text: Log in and dive into the world of the community. Here, you can connect with like-minded friends, share the latest game information, and discuss your favorite adventures.

index.title: Welcome to Wuthering.club!
index.text: Wuthering.club is an unofficial community where players who love 'Wuthering Waves' gather, talk, and create together. It exists as a place for players to express their passion, from sharing game strategy information and character analysis to fan art. We aim to create a warm community where everyone, from beginners to experts, can easily interact and exchange information. Wuthering.club is a place to deepen the bonds between players and enjoy the game more deeply. Here, you will surely find what you 'like'.
index.contactText: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
